samples.question: The image shows a closed black ring loop drawn on a white background, with a small green dot sitting in the white pocket at the center of the ring. Two colored gate markers, one red and one blue, rest on the circular path of the ring. At exactly ONE of the two gates the ring band has a real break, an open gap where the ring is not drawn, so that the sealed central pocket connects to the outside white through that opening. At the other gate the ring is a continuous, unbroken band. If the gate at the opening were removed, the green dot could pass out of the central pocket. Look at the red and blue gates. The ring is broken at exactly one of them. Which colored gate sits at the gap in the ring? Answer with exactly red or blue.
